test_case.test_name: Parameterized AMD xGMI directed-pair bandwidth matrix validation
test_case.purpose: Measure every approved directed GPU pair/direction and compare direct or indirect xGMI bandwidth with topology-specific AMD/project limits.
required_package: All GPU BDF/index/model and xGMI link topology mapping
test_case.test_command: Capture all GPU identities, xGMI topology/link counters and clock/power/thermal baseline; validate pinned compatible ROCm/tool; run complete rocm-bandwidth-test for the bound directed-pair/profile matrix without filtering; preserve raw matrix and telemetry; verify topology/link state afterward, restore temporary power settings and compare each pair/direction to its matching limit.
test_case.expected_result: Every required directed pair reports complete read/write evidence, meets its direct/indirect tolerance and leaves all GPUs/xGMI links healthy with no new error counters.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact topology, full matrix, approved aggregation and all pair-specific thresholds. Missing pair, index/BDF ambiguity, truncated output, threshold gap or link regression cannot pass.
safety_gate: Pin compatible ROCm/tool; never install an unqualified latest build.
Verify index-to-BDF and direct/indirect link map before run.
Abort on link error, reset, thermal/power limit or topology drift.
No automatic retry; restore captured power profile.
expected_evidence: GPU BDF/index and xGMI topology map
Pair-specific comparisons and final all-GPU health
test_case.recovery: On ROCm incompatibility, wrong pair mapping, link degradation or GPU reset, terminate the bandwidth process, preserve the full matrix/topology/error evidence, restore the captured power profile and use only the approved driver/reboot recovery before re-enumerating every GPU and xGMI link.
